maria_cs: Morning — dropping BluePeak weekly health snapshot. Top-line: tokens down ~6% WoW but +32% QoQ. p95 latency climbed to ~620ms (up ~120ms WoW). Error rate bumped to 0.9% in last 24h. Estimated spend up ~18% QoQ. Details below.
aj_sales: Thanks Maria — any idea if this is config or traffic pattern?
devin_eng: Looking now. They switched to quantized-2 on Tue; KV cache hit dropped notably. Also seeing more short-chat bursts which harms batching.
usage-bot: Automated usage report generated 2026-03-18T08:02:00Z
maria_cs: Quick snapshot table pasted (week start vs end):
```
metric,week_start,week_end,WoW%,QoQ%
tokens,112400,105000,-6%,+32%
p95_latency_ms,500,620,+24%,+18%
error_rate,0.4%,0.9%,+0.5pp,+0.2pp
spend,$18,200,$21,476,+18%,+45%
kv_cache_hit,72%,58%,-14pp,-6pp
throughput_rps,420,370,-12%,+9%
```
ryan_csm: Oof on kv cache. Do we know which model variant caused the hit drop?
devin_eng: Probable culprit is the quantized-2 variant with smaller cache-friendly kernels. Also their prefix distribution changed (more short prefixes). Both reduce effective KV reuse.
aj_sales: Renewal in 30 days — if we can get latency down, we might avoid pushing a concession. Can we commit to a quick mitigation?
maria_cs: Proposed mitigation: 1) trial rolling back to previous quantization for 48h, 2) apply a prefix-cache tweak on their dedicated pool, 3) share batching recommendations with devs.
devin_eng: I can flip a toggle to restore previous quantization for a controlled subset. Also suggest capping batch_size to 8 for interactive routes. I'll schedule rollback trial by 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC.
yr_usage: Note: ingest throughput dipped 12% on 2026-03-16 22:30 UTC after an AMI update — correlates with spike window.
ryan_csm: Good catch — can we ask infra to check AMI rollout logs?
devin_eng: I'll ping eng-infra; also will run a 24h KV hit-rate sampling script and post results here.
maria_cs: Enablement plan: 30-min walkthrough with their infra lead + optimization checklist. I'll set for Wed.
aj_sales: If trial improves p95 by 20% we can frame that in renewal convo. I can prepare a short SLA improvement note and an optional one-off credit if needed.
maria_cs: Action items: [Devin] run rollback trial (due 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC), [Maria] schedule enablement, [Aj] draft renewal note w/ credit scenario, [CS] monitor tokens/spend daily and report. Any objections?
aj_sales: none — :thumbsup:
devin_eng: on it.
ryan_csm: I'll join the enablement.
maria_cs: I'll post an updated mini-report after the rollback trial with fresh numbers (tokens, p95, kv_hit, errors, spend).
